reviewer: root exact module and predecessor review
assessment_basis: Manual formal consequence and full fallback/carrier scope review; no native test.
reason: The specified ordinary-branch stopping rule yields prefix-comparable supplement payloads and nested-set monotonicity. It retains every source letter in a one-unit skeleton; it is not a word-shortening rule. No actual public context grammar, complete carrier or native binding is provided, so no experiment is selected.

blockers.detail: Supply a finite publicly computable context rule and complete physical rendering, including delimiter and literal fallback, before interpreting observed variants or lengths.

all_of.detail: Specify the context rule and physical carrier with an explicit native reading consequence distinguishable from an unchanged whole-word alternative. Do not fit candidate sets to desired target supplements.

not_sufficient: A supplied answer list for each context
